tasks.spec:
You are a benchmark operator on freytag-forge. This task runs WITHOUT a sandbox and makes REAL, BILLED OpenAI judge calls, so read the hard rules first.

HARD RULES. Work ONLY inside /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-isolation/ (create files there) and write nothing under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (the repository must stay byte-for-byte unchanged; do not even create files in it). No git commands that change anything. Never print, echo or copy .env or any API key; load it only with `set -a; . /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.env; set +a` inside the command that needs it. Make EXACTLY 30 judge calls in the full run plus at most 1 smoke call, never retry a failed call more than once, never loop on errors: if a call fails twice, record the verbatim error and stop. Do not edit any source file to make anything work.

WHY. In hosted @llm-canon run 4 (no markers) the judge passed exit_motivated in scenes 1A, 1B, 1C, 2A, 3B, 3C; in run 5 (with whole-turn markers and an added prompt sentence) it passed it in 1B, 3A, 3C only. Four scenes lost it (1A, 1C, 2A, 3B) and one gained it (3A). Two things changed together: the narration (different run) and the judge prompt sentence 'Still judge authored_delivery for exit_motivated, so the player can read why the story moved on, and judge the narrator-written part of the turn normally.' This experiment holds the INPUT fixed and varies ONLY that sentence, to test whether the sentence moves exit_motivated. One sample per cell is noise-prone, so each cell is repeated 3 times.

FROZEN INPUTS (do not regenerate): /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-isolation/run5-progress.json (key by_scene: list of [sceneId, {opening, turns, revealedKnowledgeIds, ...}] exactly as run 5 judged them, including the old `authored_delivery` marker keys), the original run 5 verdicts in run5-verdicts.json, and the exact run 5 judge module roleplay-judge-run5.js (copied from git commit 7240d611; it exports judgeSceneNarration). Line 153 of roleplay-judge-run5.js is the string segment containing 'Still judge authored_delivery ...'.

STEPS:
1. Build two judge modules in the workdir: `judge-with.js` = roleplay-judge-run5.js unchanged; `judge-without.js` = the same file with ONLY that one string-segment line (line 153) deleted. Prove it: write `arm-diff.txt` containing the output of `diff roleplay-judge-run5.js judge-without.js`; it must show exactly one deleted line and no other change. The modules use createRequire for the `yaml` package and default to a repo-relative data root, so: create /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-isolation/node_modules as a symlink to /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules, and when calling judgeSceneNarration pass `canon: sceneCanon(sceneId, revealedKnowledgeIds, '/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge')` (sceneCanon is exported from the same module and takes the repo root as its third argument).
2. Write `run.mjs` that, for scenes 1A, 1C, 2A, 3A, 3B, takes that scene's entry from by_scene and calls judgeSceneNarration({ sceneId, opening, turns, revealedKnowledgeIds }, { canon }) from the with-module or the without-module, with process.env loaded (OPENAI_API_KEY; model default). Order the 30 calls INTERLEAVED to avoid time drift: for repeat in 1..3, for scene in [1A,1C,2A,3A,3B], for arm in [with_sentence, without_sentence]. Append every result as one row {scene, arm, repeat, original_run5_exit_motivated, verdict fields: exit_motivated, protected_safe, rewards_investigation, scene_local, progressive, canon_consistent, rich, verdict, reasons (array), missing_or_wrong (array)} and write the whole array to `results.json` (also write rows incrementally to results.partial.jsonl so a crash loses nothing). A call error row records {scene, arm, repeat, error: <verbatim message>} and counts toward the 30.
3. SMOKE FIRST: run a one-call smoke (scene 1A, with_sentence) with a `--smoke` flag that prints only the verdict keys (not the key, not the full prompt) and does not write results.json. If it errors, stop and report; do not run the full experiment.
4. Run the full 30 once: `set -a; . /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.env; set +a; cd /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-isolation && node run.mjs`.
5. Write `report.md` in the workdir with headings '# Sentence isolation' (what was done, in two sentences), '## Design' (scenes, arms, repeats, the arm-diff proof, interleaving, model name used), '## exit_motivated' (a table: scene | run 5 original | with_sentence: true/3 | without_sentence: true/3), '## Other checks' (for each of the other six checks, total true out of 15 per arm), '## Verdict reasons' (for each scene, one sentence quoting the judge's most common exit-related reason in each arm, verbatim), '## Limits' (n=3 per cell; same fixed input; the judge model is not deterministic; this isolates the sentence only, not the markers or the narration change; do NOT claim the sentence does or does not cause the run 4 to run 5 change unless the table clearly shows a consistent difference in the same direction in at least 4 of 5 scenes; say 'not distinguishable at this sample size' otherwise). Be strictly factual; a null result is a good result. Under 500 words.
